item.title: Rallying Cry – June 12, 2026
item.description: From Taylor Swift’s emotional Hall of Fame induction to Ukraine’s territorial gains and a potential U.S.-Iran peace deal, today’s good news includes breakthroughs in fungal research, a thriving Singapore AV trial, and even a Swift wax figure debuting in Singapore—plus, London’s 2026 theater lineup is already looking stellar!
